verdict.rationale: The franchise-tax entry page states its gates at the door: a Business Entity File Number (with a lookup link), an optional 15-digit saved session ID, an image CAPTCHA, and no account required to start. Formation is described only as fillable PDFs submitted through the Document Filing and Certificate Request Service, upload, fax, or mail, and the pack does not say what account or credentials that service needs. There is also no consolidated pre-flow statement of identity-proofing requirements. Missing for 10: a published pre-start list of account, credential, and identity-proofing steps for the Document Filing Service; an explicit statement on identity verification; any upfront disclosure of the CAPTCHA outside the entry page itself; independent or hands-on confirmation that nothing further appears mid-flow.
